# Security policy

> 🌐 Language / Ngôn ngữ: **English** | [Tiếng Việt](SECURITY.vi.md)

Do not disclose API keys, GitHub tokens, Kaggle credentials, model-access credentials, Cloudflare tunnel tokens, or private voice material in issues or pull requests.

Public exposure is supported only through the coordinator boundary and only when `API_AUTH_REQUIRED=true`. Internal workers on ports 8091 and 8092 are not public services.

For a suspected vulnerability, contact the maintainer privately at `i.am@dangkhoa.dev` with reproduction details and affected revision. Avoid publishing exploit details before a fix is available.
